text: Customers may request a return for an eligible product within the return window displayed on the product or order page.
The applicable return window may differ by product category and seller.
A return request must be submitted through the order support flow before the applicable return window expires.
Products must satisfy the applicable return-condition requirements for the return to be accepted.
Some products may be non-returnable because of product type, hygiene requirements, safety considerations, or seller-specific restrictions.
When a return request is approved, the customer may be required to provide the product for pickup or follow the applicable return instructions.
A return request may be rejected when the product is outside the eligible return period or does not satisfy the applicable return conditions.
A refund is initiated after the returned product is received and the applicable verification process is completed.
The final refund amount depends on the amount eligible for refund under the order and return conditions.
Refunds are normally issued to the original payment method unless the applicable support process specifies another method.
The time required for a refund to appear may depend on the payment method and the financial institution.
Customers should retain the return or refund reference until the refund is reflected in the relevant payment account.
If a refund has been initiated but is not visible after the expected processing period, the customer should contact support with the order and refund reference.
A refund does not necessarily mean that the original delivery or convenience charges are refundable.
A customer may request cancellation while the order is still eligible for cancellation.
Cancellation availability depends on the current order status and fulfillment stage.
An order that has already entered a non-cancellable fulfillment stage may not be cancellable through the normal cancellation flow.
If cancellation is successful, the customer receives confirmation through the applicable order or support channel.
For prepaid orders, an eligible cancellation may result in a refund according to the refund policy.
If an order cannot be cancelled because it has progressed too far in fulfillment, the customer may need to use the applicable return process after delivery if the product is eligible for return.
Customers should check the current order status before requesting cancellation.
An exchange is available only when the product and order are eligible for exchange.
Exchange eligibility can depend on product category, seller conditions, inventory availability, and the reason for the exchange.
A customer should submit an exchange request through the applicable order support flow within the permitted period.
The replacement product may be subject to availability at the time the exchange is processed.
If the requested replacement is unavailable, the customer may be offered another eligible resolution according to the order conditions.
The original product may need to be collected before or during fulfillment of the replacement.
An exchange request can be rejected when the order or product does not satisfy the applicable exchange conditions.
The estimated delivery date is shown on the order or shipment tracking information.
Delivery estimates may change because of operational conditions, transportation delays, weather, serviceability, or other fulfillment factors.
Customers can check shipment progress through the order tracking information.
If tracking shows that an order is delayed, the customer should first check the latest estimated delivery date.
If an order is marked delivered but the customer has not received it, the customer should contact support promptly and provide the order details.
Delivery to a particular address depends on the serviceability of that location.
A customer should ensure that the delivery address and contact information are correct before shipment progresses.
A customer who receives a visibly damaged product should report the issue through the applicable order support flow as soon as possible.
The customer should preserve the product, packaging, accessories, and other relevant materials until the support process provides further instructions.
Photos or other evidence of the damage may be requested during the support process.
The resolution may involve return, replacement, exchange, refund, or another applicable remedy depending on the order and product conditions.
A damaged-product request may require verification before a final resolution is approved.
Customers should not discard the damaged product or packaging before receiving instructions when a verification process may be required.
The applicable resolution depends on product eligibility and the circumstances of the reported damage.
A defective product is a product that does not function or perform as expected under its applicable product conditions.
Customers should report a suspected defect through the order support process.
The support team may request information about the defect, usage conditions, photographs, videos, or other evidence.
The available resolution may depend on the product category, seller conditions, warranty coverage, and applicable return or exchange eligibility.
A defective product may be eligible for replacement, exchange, repair, refund, or another resolution depending on the applicable conditions.
Customers should follow troubleshooting or inspection instructions provided by support before a final resolution is determined.
If the product is covered by a warranty, the warranty process may apply instead of or in addition to the standard return process.
Customers may pay for eligible orders using the payment methods presented during checkout.
Payment availability can depend on the product, seller, customer location, order value, and other transaction conditions.
A payment is considered successful only after the payment status is confirmed by the order system.
Customers should not place a duplicate order solely because a payment confirmation is delayed.
If money is debited but the order is not confirmed, the customer should retain the transaction reference and contact support when required.
A payment issue may require verification with the relevant payment provider.
Refunds for eligible cancelled or returned orders follow the applicable refund process.
Cash on Delivery, or COD, is available only for orders and locations where the payment method is offered.
COD availability may depend on product, seller, delivery location, order value, and other eligibility conditions.
The customer is expected to pay the applicable amount when the order is delivered.
The customer should keep the required payment amount ready for a COD delivery.
A COD order may be subject to additional order or verification conditions.
If COD is not displayed during checkout, the order is not currently eligible for COD under the available payment options.
Customers should check the payment options shown during checkout before placing the order.
Warranty coverage depends on the product, manufacturer, seller, and warranty terms applicable to the order.
The warranty period begins according to the applicable warranty terms.
A warranty claim may require proof of purchase and product information.
The customer may be asked to provide serial numbers, photographs, videos, or other information required to assess the claim.
Warranty resolution may include repair, replacement, or another remedy specified by the applicable warranty terms.
Damage caused by misuse, unauthorized modification, or conditions excluded by the warranty may not be covered.
Customers should review the warranty information associated with the product before submitting a warranty claim.
Products on the marketplace may be fulfilled or supplied by different sellers.
Seller-specific conditions may affect return, exchange, warranty, delivery, and other order processes.
The seller associated with an order can be identified from the applicable order or product information.
Customers should follow the support process associated with the specific order when a seller-related issue occurs.
Seller policies cannot override mandatory protections or applicable platform processes.
A seller may require product-specific information or evidence when evaluating a support request.
If a seller-related issue cannot be resolved through the normal support flow, the customer may escalate the issue through customer support.
Customers should first use the support option associated with the relevant order.
Providing the order ID and a clear description of the issue helps support identify the correct order and resolution path.
Support may request additional information to verify the issue.
Customers should provide requested evidence accurately and avoid submitting misleading information.
If an issue cannot be resolved through the initial support flow, the customer may request escalation through the available support channel.
The escalation process may require review of the order history and previously provided information.
Customers should retain relevant order, shipment, return, refund, and support reference numbers until the issue is resolved.
